newsitem.title: USA: RUGBY UNION-WALES BEAT U.S. NATIONAL TEAM 30-20 IN FIRST TEST.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WALES BEAT U.S. NATIONAL TEAM 30-20 IN FIRST TEST.

text.p: Wales, led by flyhalf Arwel Thomas, shrugged off some sweltering Carolina summer heat to beat the U.S. national rugby team 30-20 Saturday in the first of a two-test tour.
The young touring side kept their cool in weathering a competitive first half from the Eagles. At the break, Wales held an 18-13 lead.
Wales pulled away early in the second half with two tries from Thomas, who also had two conversions and kicked a pair of penalties.
"Early in the game and at the end we played the Welsh toe to toe," said U.S. head coach Jack Clark. "But credit to Wales. They are a good team and played well defensively."

The Eagles were guilty of numerous turnovers and had trouble containing the Welsh centre pairing of Gareth Thomas and Leigh Davies who, between them, broke several U.S. tackles for large territorial gains.
The teams play their second and final test in San Francisco on July 12.
United States - Tries: Tomasi Takau, Vaea Anitoni. Conversions: Matt Alexander (2). Penalties: Alexander (2)
Wales - Tries: Arwel Thomas (2), Gywn Jones, Nigel Walker. Conversions: A.Thomas (2). Penalties: A.Thomas (2).
